name: billing-console
title: Billing Console
description: The operator billing workspace for the platform or a tenant database: overview, catalog (plans and prices, entitlement matrix, meters, packs and codes), customers with credit grants, the payment provider with readiness and the gated billing switch, and platform database standing.

docs: Import: `import { BillingConsole, BILLING_CONSOLE_DEMO } from '@/components/ui/billing-console'`. Pass `data` for one billing module and route every write through the callbacks (`onSaveEntitlements`, `onConnectProvider`, `onRunReadinessCheck`, `onToggleBilling`, `onGrantCredits`, `onHoldDatabase`, and more). Credentials are write-only.
